title: awesome-dsh-plugins registry
description: Machine-readable registry of DeepSeek Harness (dsh) extensions. data/plugins.json is the source of truth; README.md is rendered from it. dsh is a developer preview with promised breaking changes, which is why every entry records the dsh version it was last verified against.

updated.description: Date the registry data was last edited (YYYY-MM-DD)

name.description: Display name, unique across the registry

path.description: Subdirectory inside the repo, for monorepo entries

description.description: One honest sentence; no keyword stuffing

category.description: Form factor. bundle: npm package with a dsh.bundle manifest that ships a patch layer. plugin: a Cordis plugin activated via patch rows. skill: Anthropic-format SKILL.md unit. theme: UI skin. tool: developer tooling around dsh.

tags.description: Functional area(s): what the extension does, orthogonal to category (its form). ui: Web GUI surfaces and interaction. terminal: TUIs and desktop shells. agents: orchestration, subagents, workflows, cross-session coordination. memory: memory systems, context management, session ops (search/rewind/export). models: providers, routing, fallbacks, subscription adapters. vision: image understanding/generation for text-only models. capabilities: model-facing tools (search, browser, files, databases, devices, media). channels: IM and remote-control bridges (Feishu, Telegram, WeCom, ...). notifications: alerting the human. usage: cost, billing, quota, token accounting. observability: diagnostics, logs, audits, evidence/provenance. marketplace: plugin stores, installers, skill managers. devtools: plugin development, testing, publishing. safety: approvals, permissions, gating, redaction. knowledge: research, RAG, learning. interop: bridges to Claude Code, Codex, and other harnesses. fun: games, pets, ambience.

stars.description: GitHub stargazer count at starsUpdated. Display and ranking signal only, refreshed by scripts/stars.mjs; absence means not yet fetched

pushedAt.description: Date of the repo's last push, refreshed alongside stars by scripts/stars.mjs. Deterministic activity signal: a registry entry can be verified yet abandoned, and readers deserve to see which

featured.description: Editor's pick, hand-curated and sparing. The gallery and README surface these first

added.description: Date the entry entered the registry

lastVerified.description: Date a maintainer last checked the entry

verifiedAgainst.description: dsh version the entry was last checked against, e.g. 0.1.0-rc.5. Undated compatibility claims rot: the .dsh-plugin manifest format was deleted 2026-08-09 with no migration.

status.description: verified: install path confirmed against verifiedAgainst (manifest or skill-layout inspection at minimum), and `evidence` says where. unverified: listed, not yet checked. broken: known not to work against verifiedAgainst.

evidence.description: Where the install path was proven, as path#key — package.json#dsh.bundle, packages/x/package.json#dependencies.@deepseek-ai/dsh-base, SKILL.md#frontmatter. Recorded by scripts/triage.mjs against the repo's default branch on lastVerified, so a reader can open the file and check. Required by status: verified; a status without one is a claim, not a check.
